title: FAce ten-format Samui commercial showcase
best_for: property, tour, dive, food, and destination sales samples
deterministic real-media stills and short vertical video
avoid_when: the source media or claims are not owner-approved
the deliverable needs generated scenery or a complex narrative
source_contract: Use owner-approved real media and approved claims only
Keep source provenance and SHA-256 evidence
creative_contract: Use the accepted blueprint matching the requested format
Protect the real subject during cropping
Keep bilingual copy sparse and Thai text correctly shaped
For 15-second reels use at least four meaningful changes and 1.5-3 second pacing
Never present generated scenery as operator media
qa_contract: Run technical QA, CRV, full playback, baseline comparison, and independent visual review
For video require 1080x1920 H.264 yuv420p 30fps AAC
Keep integrated loudness between -18 and -14 LUFS
Do not overwrite the locked baseline for a new candidate
hard_rejections: unsupported price, availability, ROI, legal, facility, or safety claim

canonical_artifacts.role: ten reproducible layout and motion blueprints

notes: Use a new dated output; rebuilding the locked baseline requires explicit FACE_ALLOW_BASELINE_REBUILD=1

proof.disposition: Owner accepted and locked the showcase as the first quality baseline
proof.qa: Ten deliverables accepted; three videos passed CRV and independent visual review; poc05 is the primary video proof
